title: Heinrich Weber: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-06-01 current Weber author record: Volume I through section 107
description:
Author record for Heinrich Weber in the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. The page keeps broad working readers for Lehrbuch der Algebra while a source-checkable German/English repair stream replaces weaker translation drafts section by section.

Status at a glance. [#########-] broad draft available; source-checked repair stream now covers Volume I through section 107, Volume II sections 176 through end matter, and Volume III sections 1-100 as paired German source and English translation readers. The next continuation points are Volume I section 108 and Volume III section 101.

The artifact ZIP preserves TeX sources, component PDFs, earlier section pairs, provenance notes, scan slices, render checks, audit notes, and source material for continued checking.
notes: Latest update supplies paired German/English high-fidelity readers for Volume I through section 107, including an individual sections 99-107 slice.
